SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: Hiki iā ʻoe ke kau inoa i nā leka me kāu mau helu wahi e hōʻoia i kou nona lākou. E makaʻala ʻaʻole e kau inoa i kekahi mea maopopo ʻole, no ka mea, e hoʻāʻo paha nā hoʻouka kaua phishing e hoʻopunipuni iā ʻoe e kau inoa i kou ʻike iā lākou. E kau inoa wale i nā ʻōlelo kikoʻī piha āu e ʻae ai.
SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: E hoʻokomo i ka helu wahi kau inoa, ka leka (e hōʻoia e kope pololei ʻoe i nā haki laina, nā hakahaka, nā ʻaoʻao, a me nā mea ʻē aʻe) a me ke kau inoa ma lalo nei e hōʻoia i ka leka. E makaʻala ʻaʻole e heluhelu hou aʻe i loko o ke kau inoa ma mua o ka mea i loko o ka leka i kau inoa ʻia, i ʻole e hoʻopunipuni ʻia e kahi hoʻouka kaua kanaka-i-waena.

GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Na nā kiaʻāina ke kuleana no ke koho balota ʻana i nā kālā o kēlā me kēia mahina a me nā loli blockchain.
